text:
Dear Mrs Pryce,
Thank you for the loan of the ledger. I have copied the tide
tables for the society and will return it by Friday.
E. Marsh
attribution: Transcribed by the Harbour Letters Society

text:
Dear Society members,
The copied ledgers are now shelved in the reading room.
Please sign the book when you borrow one.
E. Marsh, secretary
